sentences.text: Bacteroides uniformis is a common commensal bacterium of the human gut.
In mice, giving Bacteroides uniformis alleviated atherosclerosis by raising hepatic low-density lipoprotein receptor expression.
Infection is rare but reported: one case describes paediatric meningitis caused by Bacteroides uniformis following rotavirus gastroenteritis.
